init.title: Sobry options
init.description: Change the pricing settings or manage the appliances driven by the market price.

add_plan.title: Add an appliance
add_plan.description: Sobry picks the cheapest slots of the day and drives the entity you select.

data.name: Name
data.extra_hours: Extra runtime after the cheap slots
data.require_complete_data: Wait for the whole window to be priced

data_description.name: Used as the device name, for instance "Water heater".
data_description.target_entity: Left empty, the plan only publishes a binary sensor you can use in your own automations.
data_description.hours: Daily runtime to schedule during the window.
data_description.extra_hours: Keeps the appliance running that long after the last selected slot, whatever the price. Useful for a water heater whose temperature you cannot read, to be sure it finished heating.
data_description.window_start: Start of the daily window Sobry may pick slots in. Keep the same start and end for a full day.
data_description.window_end: End of the daily window. A window ending before it starts runs overnight.
data_description.max_price: Slots above this price are never selected. Leave empty to always run the requested hours.
data_description.threshold_price: Used by the "below a price threshold" mode only.
data_description.fallback_start: Fixed schedule used whenever the plan cannot decide: unreachable API, prices not published, or a window it could not fill. Leave both times empty to disable it.
data_description.fallback_end: End of the fixed fallback schedule. An end before the start runs overnight.
data_description.require_complete_data: Hold the appliance off until every price of the window is published, so the cheapest slots are not missed.
